objections.sense: level of the children of the Victors
objections.reason: Tibetan sa is bhūmi, rendered 'terre' in T155; 'niveau' is inconsistent (children field already uses 'étape' as in T155).
Gender inconsistent with T474 ('de la bodhicitta'), the established usage.
'bien' is used for welfare/good (T064, T099, T177); here it means possessions and would be confused.
dhātu is 'royaume' in children field at T317; 'monde' is used for loka (T013).
Same śikṣā is 'entraînement' in T046 children; 'apprentissage' is inconsistent.
Same name rendered 'Avitchi' in T093 children; the macron form is not child-friendly and inconsistent.
Same sense as T165, which has 'gardien des enfers' (plural).
Same sense as T165, which has 'gardien des enfers' (plural).
Children's names drop diacritics (T322 'Brahma', T73 'Manjushri'); keep consistent.
'arrogance' is already T419 (rgyags); English academic here is 'haughtiness', so 'hauteur' keeps mada/dregs pa distinct.
'le Compatissant' is the epithet of a buddha (T441, kṛpālu); dayānvita is an ordinary compassionate person.
'insouciance' means carefree lightness, not heedlessness; same term pramāda is 'manque de vigilance' in T141.
Align with T141 pramāda children (opposite of apramāda 'prudence', T394); 'négligence' is a different notion.
viparyaya is established in French as 'inversion'/erroneous view; 'perversion' wrongly suggests moral or sexual depravity.
Lifetime is 'vie' (T131, T166 'vie présente'); 'existence' is reserved for bhava (T086).
Same word (bstod) is 'compliments' in T482 and T552 children; 'louange' is harder for ages 8-12 and inconsistent.
Renunciation is 'renonciation' in T456; 'renoncement' is also drafted for relinquishment (T517, T518), causing a clash.
'appréhension' is the established rendering of dmigs pa (T286, T623, T633, T691); bhaya (fear of wrongdoing) needs a different word.
Same cintāmaṇi as T625; 'vœux' also means 'vow' (T305). Align both on 'souhaits'.
Same cintāmaṇi as T625; align on 'souhaits' ('vœux' also means vow).
'vœux' also means 'vow'; 'souhaits' is used for yid bzhin in T625 and the children field here.
